notes.title: Watch Your Eggs! Survival VR demo is out now!
notes.notes:
Great news! You can now play the demo version of Watch Your Eggs! Survival VR. 

Step into Agent Pop’s shoes as he embarks on a mission to safeguard precious penguin eggs. Strategize, team up with your penguin allies, and use an array of upgradable weapons to fight off waves of relentless Icy Land enemies. 

Give this sneak peek a try, and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Exciting news: Watch Your Eggs! VR is live on Steam!
notes.notes: Are you up for an exciting and enjoyable VR experience that the entire family can enjoy? Head over to the Watch Your Eggs! store page, and feel free to add this winterish penguin game to your Wishlist while we’re putting the finishing touches on the demo version.
